output.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.net_revenue), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Average order value is the mean net_revenue per order, limited to revenue orders (is_revenue = true) with order_date in calendar year 2025. Orders that are not revenue-generating are excluded. Net revenue is used as the order value because it is the revenue measure after discounts. The result is rounded to 2 decimals.
